what: Beimen salt-pan chapter art. Every PNG is a built-in image_gen original delivered by root and copied byte-for-byte; textures are rebuilt in memory by game/scripts/salt_art.gd and salt_props_art.gd with fixed per-cell windows and nearest sampling (no per-state autocrop, no hand edits).
copied_by: flower_exec_salt_scene (except salt-props.png: lead copy, re-verified here)
fiction: 鹽風合作鹽田, 阿曬, gates and machines are original fiction; no text/logos in art.

salt-terrain.png.windows: 4x4 cells, boundaries 0,314,627,941,1254; each tile = its whole cell (clipped, no neighbour bleed) -> 32x32 nearest (SaltArt.terrain_window); sea_b/channel_b never alternated

salt-pan-states.png.windows: 4x2 cells x 0,444,887,1331,1774 / y 0,444,887; one cell-relative window (25,16,396,396) for all 8 states -> 96x96 nearest, rim centred on the 3x3 footprint; brine_alt never drawn

salt-machines.png.windows: 2x2 cells of 627; empty pads wheel (30,12,576,576), collector (10,11,576,576) -> 64x64 feet (32,64); collector working cell window (11,12,576,576) used ONLY as a source of RAKE_ROI/GRAIN_ROI pixels composited onto the idle props frame; raw working frames never drawn whole

salt-resident.png.windows: 2x2 cells of 627 (front, front_blink, back, right); one cell-relative window (118,5,400,600) -> 32x48, feet (16,48); left = mirror of right; blink not animated (not root-approved)

salt-items.png.windows: 2x2 cells of 627 (sea_salt, salt_wheel_kit, salt_rake_kit, salt_grilled_fish); whole cell -> 32x32

salt-props.png.windows: staged adapter salt_props_art.gd (copied by lead): 2x2 cells of 627, 576 windows -> 64x64, foot (32,64)

adapter: game/scripts/salt_art.gd = root-reviewed staged adapter work/salt/staged-full-art/salt_art.gd (sha256 4d9dbdb60cf1bbd898c76a1d11341e28c7e66be4e72d0cdcb174da96bfe6d5df) + production panel_art(); reconciled by flower_exec_salt_scene2 2026-11-14. Haze alpha<=8 zeroed on textures built from these sheets.
animation: Running machines: idle salt-props frame always drawn; only SaltArt.animated_rois change (waterwheel flume/outlet water pixels advanced 2px/phase, wheel does not rotate; collector tray rake from the registered working cell + real grain pixels). 4 phases x 0.15 s. Reduced motion and every non-running status = the identical idle texture. Sea/channel tiles static; brine_alt and blink unused.
